collisionNote: Base and StepStone are BlockAll with importer-generated simple collision (auto_generate_collision True on those two imports; the tending stone is a walkable prop and the plinth must not be walked through). limitations: Original interpretive model guided by the Torah/Talmud counts and the TI photograph's silhouette; not a measured TI replica (menorah-model-spec claims_not_allowed). Lamp pitch, branch section, ornament profiles, plinth and stone sizes are artistic (geometry-manifest dimensions table).
Rambam north-south orientation selected (book 22:23b); the Rashi east-west alternative (22:23a) is not modelled.
Wick nozzles follow Rambam 3:8 (six toward the centre, centre toward the west); no flames, oil or service tools.
BlockAll on the plinth and the stone relies on importer-generated simple collision; walkability of the 16.7 cm steps against the 55 cm step height is not tested here.
Import, material assignment, winding check and placement are geometric only; no visual, lighting or packaged acceptance is established.
The removed CC BY menorah asset stays on disk; Content/Distribution/CREDITS.txt is not edited by this script.
